rationale: Kevin's work on AI-driven quality assurance and ML infrastructure aligns well with Simone's deep technical expertise in cloud-native infrastructure and AI workloads—both are navigating how AI fundamentally changes their respective domains. As a CEO building AI testing products and a marketing leader at a Kubernetes infrastructure company, they can exchange perspectives on how technical teams adopt and articulate AI-driven solutions in complex infrastructure environments.
intro_message: Kevin Kissi, meet Simone Morellato — you both work at the intersection of AI and infrastructure (QA automation and cloud-native systems), and could compare notes on how technical teams adopt these emerging capabilities.
